3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Structural Steel Detailer
•	Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Monte Construction PTY LTD is an Australian structural steel construction company dedicated to delivering high-quality steel fabrication and construction solutions across commercial, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. With a team of experienced engineers, detailers, and fabricators, Monte Construction specialises in the design, detailing, fabrication, and erection of structural steelwork for a diverse range of projects — from multi-storey commercial buildings and industrial facilities to bridges and civil structures. 

About the role
The Structural Steel Detailer transforms architectural and engineering plans into precise 3D models and 2D shop drawings. This role ensures all steelwork is detailed accurately for fabrication and erection. The position requires strict adherence to Australian Standards and project specifications. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between structural design and practical fabrication.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Generate detailed fabrication drawings, erection plans, and assembly drawings.
•	Produce accurate Bill of Materials (BOM), cutting lists, and bolt lists for procurement.
•	Identify and resolve design clashes before fabrication commences.
•	Draft and submit Requests for Information (RFIs) to engineers or architects to resolve design discrepancies.
•	Liaise with the workshop to resolve fabrication queries and optimize detailing for manufacturing efficiency.
•	Work with site supervisors to ensure erection plans are clear and practical.
•	Ensure all detailing complies with the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Update models and drawings promptly to reflect design changes and site variations.
•	Maintain accurate records of drawing issues, revisions, and transmittals.
•	Self-check all drawings for dimensional accuracy and completeness prior to formal review.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive knowledge of AS 4100 (Steel structures), AS/NZS 1554 (Structural steel welding), and AS 5131 (Structural steelwork fabrication and erection).
•	High level of accuracy in drafting and mathematical calculations.
•	Ability to visualize complex 3D structures from 2D architectural and engineering plans.
•	Proven ability to manage multiple project deadlines simultaneously.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical coordination.
•	Proactive approach to identifying design flaws and proposing practical solutions.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Trade qualification or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $75,000-$95,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

## ICT Support and Test Engineers (nec)
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Support and Test Engineer to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and quality of our systems and infrastructure. This role combines technical support, quality assurance, and systems testing to ensure seamless operations and adherence to established standards. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a solid foundation in ICT systems and environments. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality technical outcomes.
## Key Responsibilities
- Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections across systems, data, and documentation, identifying variations and potential high-risk areas to ensure continued adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve system problems and performance issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting support for desktops, hardware, software, printers, databases, operating systems, email platforms, and network connectivity.
- Test the functionality, behaviour, and integrity of systems and application code within defined testing protocols and quality frameworks, identifying and documenting errors, faults, and deviations from specification.
- Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance processes, guidelines, and strategies to support system reliability, security, and performance across the organisation.
- Recommend and facilitate corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues identified through ongoing monitoring, auditing, and review of operational processes and procedures.
- Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, providing well-informed recommendations on current and future hardware and software strategies aligned with business needs.
- Develop and deliver technical guidance, training, and support to end users and stakeholders on application software, operational procedures, and best practice usage.
- Communicate and liaise effectively with users and management to promote awareness of quality control standards, data integrity requirements, and ICT compliance obligations.
- Create, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, technical specifications, testing reports, and maintenance inventory records.
- Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, installations, configurations, and patch management activities to minimise disruption and maintain system availability.
- Monitor and evaluate system infrastructure to proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, contributing to the ongoing optimisation of ICT environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders to support the delivery of ICT initiatives and ensure quality outcomes are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar ICT role.
- Proven experience in ICT technical support, systems testing, or quality assurance within a professional environment.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, quality assurance frameworks, and audit processes across systems and software.
- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across a broad range of ICT systems, including hardware, software, operating systems, and network components.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation such as test plans, procedural guides, specifications, and operational manuals.
- Solid knowledge of database management, system security, backup procedures, and infrastructure performance monitoring.
- Proficiency in diagnosing software and hardware faults and delivering appropriate solutions within agreed timeframes and service levels.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to quality assurance and issue resolution.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing competing priorities and deadlines effectively.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, ISTQB (Software Testing), or Microsoft Certified qualifications.
- Experience with enterprise-level systems, cloud platforms, or virtualisation technologies such as AWS, Azure, or VMware.
- Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk.
- Exposure to Agile or DevOps delivery environments and associated testing practices such as continuous integration and automated testing.
- Previous experience conducting formal ICT audits, architecture reviews, or compliance assessments.
- Knowledge of relevant Australian and international ICT standards and frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001 or COBIT.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
- Access ongoing learning and development opportunities, including support for professional certifications and industry training.
- Enjoy a flexible work environment with options for hybrid working arrangements to support work-life balance.
- Contribute to meaningful, large-scale ICT projects that have a real impact on organisational performance and service delivery.
- Competitive salary package with opportunities for career progression within a growing and dynamic technology function.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

We are a growing Australian business group operating across wholesale distribution, event services and education. As our organisation continues to expand and diversify, we are seeking an experienced and highly organised Office Manager to oversee our administrative and operational functions and support the continued growth of the business.

This is a senior, hands-on role suited to a proactive professional who thrives in a dynamic environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading office operations, developing efficient business systems, coordinating multiple business functions, and supporting strategic initiatives that drive organisational growth and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

- Lead and oversee the day-to-day office operations across multiple business divisions.
- Develop, implement and continuously improve office procedures, administrative systems and operational workflows.
- Coordinate communication and workflow across departments to ensure efficient and effective business operations.
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement initiatives that increase efficiency, streamline processes and support sustainable business growth.
- Lead the implementation, optimisation and integration of enterprise business systems, digital workflow platforms and business automation technologies.
- Coordinate supplier relationships, purchasing activities and operational logistics.
- Prepare management reports, operational documentation and business performance information to support informed decision-making.
- Assist with budgeting, resource planning and business administration.
- Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, staff administration and HR documentation.
- Maintain company policies, compliance records and organisational documentation.
- Support directors in delivering strategic projects, organisational change initiatives and business expansion activities.
- Establish scalable administrative systems and operational processes to support future growth.

Skills & Experience

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

- A minimum of three years' experience in an Office Manager, Operations Coordinator, Business Operations or similar management role.
- Demonstrated experience managing office operations within a growing, multi-site or multi-faceted business environment.
- Proven experience implementing or improving enterprise business systems, ERP, CRM or other integrated business management platforms.
- Experience leading business process improvement, workflow optimisation and automation initiatives.
- Strong organisational, project coordination and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Experience developing and maintaining business policies, procedures and operational documentation.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
- High-level computer literacy, including Microsoft 365 and cloud-based business applications.
- Experience with bookkeeping processes, reporting and business administration.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- A proactive, adaptable and solutions-focused approach with a commitment to continuous improvement.

What We Offer

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation where you will play a key role in strengthening business operations, implementing scalable systems and supporting the continued growth of multiple business divisions.

If you are an experienced Office Manager looking for a challenging and rewarding role where you can make a genuine impact, we encourage you to apply by submitting your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

result.description: Quadient Australia  Quadient Australia Pty Ltd helps companies deliver meaningful interactions with current and future customers. The Quadient portfolio of technology enables organizations to create better experiences for their customers through timely, personalized, optimized, and highly individualized communications for all channels. Our solutions bring together and activate the entire organization in the name of customer experience, through better collaboration and visibility into the customer journey.  At Quadient, we support businesses of all sizes in their digital transformation and growth journey, unlocking operational efficiency with reliable, secure, and sustainable automation processes.  Our success in delivering innovation and business growth is inspired by the connections our diverse teams create every day, with our clients and each other.  It’s these connections that make Quadient such an exceptional place to grow your career, develop your skills and make a real impact – help our future-focused business lead the way in powering secure and sustainable business connections through digital and physical channels.  To support our growth and our Australian and NZ customers in planning and implementation of the CCM solutions, we are extending our PSO team and need a full time Professional Services Principal Consultant with extensive experience in the Quadient solutions and CXM solutions who will be dedicated to the success of customers’ Customer communication strategies and their implementations. A successful candidate will influence the success of each implementation forming a vital link between the customer and Quadient. We’ve learned that if we put our thinking and efforts together, we’ll achieve better results for decisions big and small. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute at a high level because the way we see it, your input broadens our perspective as well as yours.  The position is based in Sydney, NSW. The offered remuneration $160,000 - $200,000pa + super depends on your experience and skills.      Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Main Duties:.    Software Development & Integration: Programming custom software solutions in JavaScript, Java, Groovy, and the native Quadient Inspire Designer scripting language. This includes developing custom database connectors, integration components, and scripts that communicate with native Quadient programs  Custom Database Creation: Executing the physical creation and configuration of custom database environments utilizing relational management engines, specifically Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL.  Systems Installation & Server Deployments: Deploying and installing the finalized Customer Communications Management (CCM) solutions and core Quadient applications directly on customer servers, managing both Windows and Linux operating systems.  Quality Assurance, Testing & Debugging: Running post-deployment verification test suites, diagnosing programming faults, debugging system errors, and fixing the software to align with defined client specifications.  Technical Documentation Writing: Authoring detailed solution documentation (to describe implemented product features), server-side installation guidelines (detailing operating specifications), and testing documentation (outlining individual validation test cases).       Key Responsibilities:    Solution Analysis & System Design: Taking complete ownership of analyzing client-side needs and designing overarching future target system topographies.  Enterprise Architecture Formulation: Authoring comprehensive, high-level solution architecture maps and design specifications aligned with the TOGAF framework.  Requirements Engineering & Business Analysis: Fact-finding and gathering client-side requirements, and executing structured business analysis workflows based on the Business Analysis Body of Knowledge (BABOK) framework.  Cloud Infrastructure Design: Architecting deployment topologies, sizing models, and installation structures specifically for hosting environments in the cloud (AWS / Azure).  Stakeholder Consultation & Advisory: Leading consulting workshops with customer Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across diverse fields to guarantee that proposed target systems cover all technical and organizational needs.  Project Sizing & Resource Estimation: Formulating accurate project estimations regarding deployment timelines, staffing structures, and computer resources required for end-to-end implementation.  Product Gap Analysis & R&D Alignment: Performing gap analyses of standard Quadient applications to isolate missing software features relative to client needs, and leading structured collaborations with the global Research & Development (RND) division to design solutions for these gaps.          Qualification & experience   Essential Skills Criteria:    at least ICT Bachelor's Degree and 3 years relevant work experience  demonstrable experience in Solution analysis and architecture including needs/business analysis, consultation based on Quadient software. writing solution architecture and design documentation and designing architecture of installations/deployments in the cloud  5 years’ experience using Quadient Software and 7 years’ experience in CXM  extensive experience in development, including programming in JavaScript, Java, Groovy, and preferably with Quadient Inspire Designer scripting language  demonstrable working experience and knowledge of application development, databases and analytical tools, and design functional specifications, with a strong understanding of enterprise applications  proven experience in the design and implementation of custom databases, creating them in MS SQL, Oracle and PostgreSQL, designed to customer requirements.
